justifications.fit: the rewritten cases keep the surrounding dispatch and fixture helpers, the changed docstring reads as the new behaviour rather than the old, and the plan and archive entries are appended rather than rewritten.

justifications.scope_discipline: the three commits touch only tests/test_crew.py, tests/test_ledger.py, tests/test_crew_members.py, the plan page, the evidence archive and one figure; no reckon/ source file appears in the diff.
